user.title: Fujitsu General IR
user.description:
Detected IR proxy: {detected}.

The emitter (and a matching receiver) are pre-filled below — just confirm, or change them if you have several proxies.

data.name: Name
data.receiver_entity_id: Infrared receiver (optional, tracks the original remote)
data.power_sensor_entity_id: Power sensor (optional, detects on/off from the AC's draw)
data.power_on_threshold: On threshold in watts (draw at or above this counts as on)

abort.already_configured: This infrared emitter is already configured.
abort.no_ir_proxy: No infrared proxy found. Add an IR-proxy device (e.g. a XIAO IR Mate on the ESPHome IR-proxy firmware) so an `infrared` emitter entity appears in Home Assistant, then start setup again.
